verdict.rationale: Hugging Face's Inference Providers route requests to the fastest available provider by default, using a `:fastest` policy defined as highest throughput in tokens per second. Developers can also pin a specific provider, and the homepage advertises optimized Inference Endpoints. This covers the high-throughput half of the story, but nothing documents time-to-first-token or latency guarantees for latency-sensitive serving. missing for 10: documented time-to-first-token or latency metrics and guarantees, benchmarks or independent hands-on evidence of serving speed, detail on how Inference Endpoints are optimized for latency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve latency-sensitive workloads with fast time-to-first-token and high-throughput generation

citations.quote: By default, our system automatically selects the fastest available provider for the specified model (equivalent to the `:fastest` policy — highest throughput in tokens per second).
Reducing reasoning effort can result in faster responses and fewer tokens used on reasoning.
